validation.positiveInteger: Enter a whole number above zero
validation.nonZeroInteger: Enter a whole number, but not zero

auth.headline: The notebook behind every Sudanese certificate paper.
auth.lede: Review Bankak receipts, publish past papers, and keep the credit ledger honest — from one console.
auth.fact1Text: Prices, marks and credit balances are computed on the server. The console only shows them.
auth.fact2Text: Approvals, blocks, imports and settings edits all write an audit entry with before and after.
auth.fact3Text: Paid answer keys are never sent to a student before the exam is unlocked.
auth.formSubtitle: Admin accounts only. Students sign in from the mobile app.
auth.phoneHint: The number registered for your admin account.
auth.consoleOnly: This console is for staff. If you are a student, use the Mothakira app.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
auth.accountBlocked: This account is blocked. Contact the owner.
auth.offlineText: Your session is saved. Check the connection and try again.

payments.title: Payment review
payments.subtitle: Oldest requests first. Approve only after the receipt matches the expected amount.

empty.title: Nothing in this queue
empty.text: No payment requests match the current filter.

detail.title: Payment {{code}}
detail.duplicate: This reference appears on another account
detail.duplicateHint: Check both requests before approving either one.

checklist.title: Verification checklist
checklist.subtitle: All four must be true. The server refuses an incomplete checklist.
checklist.amount_matchesHint: The transfer equals the expected amount, including the increment.
checklist.date_recentHint: The transfer date is close to the submission date.
checklist.reference_matchesHint: The bank reference on the receipt matches the one submitted.
checklist.receiver_account_oursHint: The receiving account is the Bankak account shown above.

payments.approveDisabled: Confirm all four checklist items first
payments.rejectSubtitle: The student sees this reason and can submit a new receipt.
payments.rejectPlaceholder: Explain exactly what did not match, e.g. amount is 4,500 SDG but 5,000 SDG was expected.
payments.approvedText: {{credits}} credits were added to the student wallet.
payments.rejectedText: The student can submit a corrected receipt.
payments.notReviewable: This request is already decided. Only submitted requests can be reviewed.

users.title: Students and staff
users.subtitle: Search by name or phone, then open a record to manage credits and access.
users.searchHint: Both 09… and +249… forms match the same student.

empty.title: No matching people
empty.text: Try a shorter search term or part of the phone number.

users.adminNoWallet: Staff accounts have no credit wallet.
users.blockSubtitle: The student is signed out immediately and cannot sign in until unblocked.
users.blockPlaceholder: Why is this account being blocked?
users.unblockSubtitle: Access is restored immediately. The block reason stays in the audit log.
users.cannotBlockAdmin: Staff accounts cannot be blocked from the console.
users.grantSubtitle: Creates a new credit lot. Grants are recorded in the ledger and the audit log.
users.grantExpiryHint: Leave empty to use the free-grant expiry from settings. 0 means no expiry.
users.adjustSubtitle: Positive adds credits, negative removes them from the earliest-expiring lots.
users.adjustHint: A whole number, never zero. Negative values deduct.
users.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the change so the audit log stays useful.

exams.title: Past papers
exams.subtitle: Import, review and publish certificate papers with their marking keys.

empty.title: No papers yet
empty.text: Import a paper from CSV to see it here.

exams.publishSubtitle: Students will see it in the app. Publishing is refused if any paid key is still a draft.
exams.unpublishSubtitle: The paper returns to draft. Existing unlocks are kept.
exams.blockSubtitle: A blocked paper disappears from the app and cannot be unlocked.
exams.blockPlaceholder: Why is this paper being blocked?

config.title: Access and pricing
config.subtitle: The server prices every unlock. These values are the only inputs it accepts.
config.isFreeHint: Free papers expose their keys without an unlock.
config.unlockCostHint: Leave empty to use the credits.exam_unlock setting. 0 makes it free to unlock.
config.practiceHint: Allows single-question practice attempts on this paper.
config.noChanges: Change at least one value to save.

exams.keysWarning: Draft keys are visible to staff only. Students never receive a paid key before unlocking.

import.title: Import papers
import.subtitle: Check the CSV files first, read every warning, then apply. Nothing is written during a check.
import.dropHint: Drop a CSV here, or choose a file. UTF-8, up to {{size}}.
import.noErrors: No errors. The files are ready to apply.
import.dryRunFailed: Check failed — fix the errors below
import.applyOkText: Open the papers list to review and publish them.
import.needBoth: Choose both exams.csv and questions.csv before checking.
import.contract: exams.csv needs exam_key, language, subject, class_level, exam_year, session, total_marks, duration_minutes, source, rights_note, status. questions.csv needs exam_key, path, type, text, options, key, accepted_alternatives, marks, criteria, model_answer, explanation, normalisation, key_status, sort_order, access, marking_method.

fileError.READ_FAILED: The file could not be read. Try saving it again as UTF-8 CSV.

topics.title: Topics
topics.subtitle: Topic keys tag questions and drive the mastery reports later.
topics.keyHint: Letters, numbers, dot, underscore or dash. Example: algebra.quadratics

empty.title: No topics yet
empty.text: Create the first topic key to start tagging questions.

packages.title: Credit packages
packages.subtitle: Prices are locked into each payment request when it is created.

empty.title: No packages
empty.text: Create a package so students can buy credits.

packages.noDelete: Packages are retired, never deleted — past payments keep their price snapshot.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Bank details and credit rules. Every change is audited with its previous value.

hint.bankak.account_name: Shown to students on the transfer screen.
hint.bankak.account_number: The account every receipt must be paid into.
hint.bankak.bank_name: Bank name shown with the account.
hint.credits.signup_bonus: Granted once when a student registers.
hint.credits.unit_sdg: Price of one credit unit in SDG.
hint.credits.exam_unlock: Used when a paper has no unlock cost of its own.
hint.payments.max_open_requests: Stops a student opening unlimited parallel requests.

empty.title: No settings
empty.text: The server returned no configuration keys.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every admin mutation, newest first, with the values before and after.
audit.noChange: No field values recorded for this entry.

reports.title: Question reports
reports.subtitle: Students flag wrong keys and unclear questions. Resolve or dismiss with a note.
reports.resolveSubtitle: Use this when the question or key was corrected.
reports.dismissSubtitle: Use this when the report does not need a change.
reports.notePlaceholder: What was done, or why no change is needed.
reports.bulkSubtitle: Each report is closed separately. Already-closed reports are skipped by the server.

error.title: Could not load this
error.text: The server did not return the data. Nothing was changed.

forbidden.title: Not available for your role
forbidden.text: Your account cannot open this area. Ask the owner if you need access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: That address does not exist in the console.
